tool.name: bcftools @EXECUTABLE@
tool.command:
@PREPARE_INPUT_FILES@ #set $section = $sec_restrict @PREPARE_REGIONS_FILE@
bcftools @EXECUTABLE@
## Default section #set $section = $sec_default
#if $section.mode.naive == "yes": #if $section.mode.naive_force: --naive-force #else: --naive #end if #else: #if $section.mode.overlaps.allow_overlaps == 'yes': --allow-overlaps #if $section.mode.overlaps.rm_dups: --rm-dups $section.mode.overlaps.rm_dups #end if #end if #if $section.mode.ligate: ${section.mode.ligate} #if $section.mode.ligate_mode: $section.mode.ligate_mode #end if ${section.compact_PS} #if str($section.min_PQ): --min-PQ ${section.min_PQ} #end if #else: #if $section.drop_genotypes: --drop-genotypes #end if #end if #end if
#if $section.mode.naive != "yes": #set $section = $sec_restrict @REGIONS@ #end if
## General options #set $section = $sec_general @NO_VERSION@
#if $sec_default.mode.naive == "yes": #if $output_type == 'v': --output-type 'z' #else: @OUTPUT_TYPE@ #end if #else: @OUTPUT_TYPE@ #end if @THREADS@
## Primary Input/Outputs @INPUT_FILES@ #if $sec_default.mode.naive == "yes" and $output_type == 'v': > output.gz && bcftools index output.gz && bcftools view -O v -o '$output_file' output.gz #else: > '$output_file' #end if

param.label: Naive concat
param.help: --naive concatenates VCF or BCF files without recompression. This can be used to combine results that were generated separately for each chromosome. This is very fast but requires that all files are of the same type (all VCF or all BCF) and have identical headers. Cannot be combined with --allow-overlaps, --ligate, --drop-genotypes, or region filtering.

param.label: Naive force
param.help: Same as --naive, but does not check if the headers of all input files are compatible. This can be dangerous and cause corrupted files if headers differ. Use with caution!

param.label: Allow Overlaps
param.help: With this option enabled the tool will handle inputs with overlapping variant positions, i.e. the first coordinate of an input can safely precede the last record of the previous input without messing up the sort order in the output. Without the option concatenation can run faster, but it's your responsibility to provide non-overlapping inputs in the first place.

param.label: Remove duplicates resulting from concatenation of
param.help: The following rules are applied depending on your selection: SNPs - of SNP records affecting the same genomic position only the first one is kept regardless of whether the ALT alleles match or not; indels - of indel records affecting the same genomic position only the first one is kept regardless of whether the REF and ALT alleles match or not; both - deduplicates both SNP and indel records according to the previous rules; all - deduplicates all kinds of records according to the rules for SNPs; exact - deduplicates all kinds of records if they match exactly considering REF and ALT.

param.name: ligate
param.label: Ligate
param.help: Ligate phased VCFs by matching phase at overlapping haplotypes. Cannot be combined with Allow Overlaps (--allow-overlaps), Naive concat (--naive), or Drop genotypes (--drop-genotypes). Please run with Ligate only when dealing with overlapping phased chunks.

param.name: ligate_mode
param.label: Ligate mode
param.help: Finer control of --ligate behavior (only applicable when Ligate is enabled)
param.option: Ligate warn: Drop sites that are present in one chunk but absent in the other (--ligate-warn)
Ligate force: Keep sites that are present only in one chunk (--ligate-force)

param.name: compact_PS
param.label: Compact Ps
param.help: Do not output PS tag at each site, only at the start of a new phase set block. Note: This option is intended only with Phased Concat (--ligate).

param.name: min_PQ
param.label: Min Pq
param.help: Break phase set if phasing quality is lower than <int>. Note: This option is intended only with Phased Concat (--ligate).

param.label: Drop individual genotype information
param.help: Drop individual genotype information. Note: Cannot be combined with Phased Concat (--ligate) or Naive concat (--naive).
